_readme: Copy to appsettings.Worker.Production.json, replace every <...> value, and give it to dashboard\Install-CopilotInsights.ps1 -WorkerServer -WorkerSettingsFile on the one server that runs the worker; it is installed next to the worker as appsettings.Production.json. The installer fills in ConnectionStrings:GovernanceWorker and Notifications:WorkbenchBaseUrl (the site's address, without /workbench) where they are still <...>. These are the exact names the worker reads (governance/src/Governance.Worker, Governance.Infrastructure, Governance.Notifications). No secrets here: Graph, Power Platform and the channel flow use the worker certificate found by subject (LocalMachine\My is searched after CurrentUser\My), SQL uses Windows authentication as the worker gMSA. The ITSM password and the channel flow URL carry secrets: set them as machine environment variables for the service account (Itsm__Password, Notifications__ChannelFlowUrl), never in this file (governance/deploy/Deploy-Production.md, step 8.3).

Tenant.WorkerClientId: <Worker app registration client ID for this environment>
Tenant.TeamsAppId: <Teams app ID from the org catalog>
Tenant.CatalogId: <entitlement management catalog ID of the governed access packages>

Notifications.SmtpHost: <internal SMTP relay host, or empty for no fallback>
